motions.motion_text: Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Council Member Morzel, to approve Consent Agenda Item 3A through 3C.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 9-0. Vote taken at 6:55 PM.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Jones moved, seconded by Council Member Weaver, to adopt Ordinance No. 790 submitting to the registered electors of the City of Bowling Green at the special municipal coordinated election to be held on Tuesday, November 4, 2014, the question of affirming the city's right to provide high-speed internet services (advanced services), telecommunications services, and/or cable television services to residents, businesses, schools, libraries, non-profit entities and other users of such services and setting forth related details.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 20. Vote taken at 7:14 PM.

motions.motion_text: Mayor Appelhorn moved, seconded by Council Member Weaver, to continue this item until the regular meeting on August 19, 2014.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 20. Vote taken at 7:14 PM.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Plass moved, seconded by Council Member Shoemaker, to adopt Ordinance No. 7982 submitting to the registered elections of the City of Boulder a the Special Coordinated Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, November 4, 2014, the question of amending City Charter Section 9 to provide that the city council may meet in executive session only for the purpose of discussing legal advice and negotiation strategy relating to the creation of a municipal electric utility with such authority ending December 31, 2017, setting forth the ballot title and specifying the form of the ballot and all ancillary items.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 94. Vote taken at 8:13 PM.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Karakenian moved seconded by Council Member Shoemaker to approve Ordinance No. 7983 as amended by the minor corrections presented by the City Attorney on the peach colored handout and by amending the short title of the ballot issue to read "temporary tax increase for Community Culture and Safety."
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 90%. Vote was taken at 9:13 PM.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Murra moved, seconded by Council Member Weaver, to adopt Resolution No. 1136 and Resolution No. 1137, finding the properties located at 4270 19th St and 2130 Tamarack Ave. to be unlivable, finding compliance with statutory requirements applicable to these annexations and establishing August 3, 2014 is the date for Council action and to adopt Emergency Ordinance No. 7984 and Emergency Ordinance No. 7985 amending the properties with a final zoning classification of Residential - Estate4 (RB).
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7-1 with Councilman absent at 9:47 PM.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Weaver moved, seconded by Council Member Jones, to accept the 2017 Transportation Master Plan and to accept the revised Transportation Master Plan Summary for inclusion in the Boulder Valley Comprehensive Plan.
Mayor Appelbaum moved, seconded by Council Member Pass, to ratify the Board and Commission appointments.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 6-6. Vote taken at 11:57 PM.

agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council Member Cowles noted that the Comprehensive Housing Strategy would be have a public hearing on September 2, 2014.

agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Appelhorn moved, seconded by Council Member Weaver, to continue this item until the regular meeting on August 19, 2014. The motion carried 20.

agenda_items.title: B. SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. 792 SUBMITTING TO THE REGISTERED ELECTORS OF THE CITY OF BOWLING GREEN AT THE SPECIAL, COORDINATED MUNICIPAL ELECTION TO BE HELD ON TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 4, 2014, THE QUESTION OF AMENDING CITY CHARTER SECTION 9 TO PROVIDE THAT THE CITY COUNCIL MAY MEET IN EXECUTIVE SESSION ONLY FOR THE PURPOSE OF DISCUSSING LEGAL ADVICE AND NEGOTIATION STRATEGY RELATING TO THE CREATION OF A MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC UTILITY, WITH SUCH AUTHORITY ENDING DECEMBER 31, 2017; SETTING FORTH THE DATES, TIMELINES, AND SPECIFYING THE FORM OF AGREEMENT AND OTHER RELATED DETAILS
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Vote was taken on the motion to improve Ordinance No. 7982 submitting to the registered elections of the City of Boulder a the Special Coordinated Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, November 4, 2014, the question of amending City Charter Section 9 to provide that the city council may meet in executive session only for the purpose of discussing legal advice and negotiation strategy relating to the creation of a municipal electric utility with such authority ending December 21, 2017, sent to the ballot measure and stated a return to the ballot and other related details, as amended. The motion carried 94.

agenda_items.title: C. SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. 7983 SUBMITTING TO THE REGISTERED ELECTORS OF THE CITY OF BOUNDER, AT THE SPECIAL MUNICIPAL COORDINATED ELECTION TO BE HELD ON TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 4, 2014, THE QUESTION OF AUTHORIZING THE CITY COUNCIL TO INCREASE THE SALES AND INS TAX BY 0.333 CENT ON EVERY DOLLAR, EFFECTIVE FROM JANUARY 1, 2015 THROUGH DECEMBER 31, 2017 FOR THE PURPOSE OF FUNDING A VARIETY OF CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECTS, GIVING APPROVAL FOR THE COLLECTION, RETENTION AND EXPENDITURE OF THE FULL TAX PROCEEDS AND ANY RELATED EARNINGS, NOTWITHSTANDING ANY STATE REVENUE OR EXPENDITURE LIMITATION, AND SETTING FORTH THE EFFECTIVE DATE, TITLE OF TITLE, AMENDMENTS TO SECTION 1-2-1, "RATE OF TAX," R.R.C. 1-28 AND RELATED DETAILS
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Vote was taken on the motion to approve Ordinance No. 793 as amended by the minor commission presented by the City Attorney on the beach colored handout and to amend the wording of the ballot issue to read "Temporary Tax Increase for Community, Culture and Safety." The motion carried 90%.

agenda_items.outcome_summary: Vote was taken on the motion to accept the 2018 Transportation Master Plan and to accept the revised Transportation Master Plan Summary for inclusion in the Boulder Valley Comprehensive Plan. The motion carried 24-0 (Unanimous).
